name: Broiled Chicken Thighs & Mushrooms with Creamy Zucchini-Parmesan Rice
ingredients: 24 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, salt, and garlic powder to the pan; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
While the broth is heating, trim and coarsely grate the zucchini.

Once the broth comes to a boil, add zucchini and stir the mixture; cover the saucepan and reduce heat to low. Cook zucchini-rice until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan.
Halve mushrooms and add to the baking sheet with the chicken.
Drizzle chicken and mushrooms with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping the chicken halfway through, until chicken and mushrooms are golden brown and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces.
When the zucchini-rice is done, add chives and Parmesan to the pan and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken, mushrooms, and zucchini-chive rice between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
